title: SAPS Launches R600 Million Operation Against Anti-Immigrant Unrest
detail: South African Police Service has launched a R600 million operation to counter anti-immigrant unrest ahead of a June 30 government deadline. The large-scale deployment targets areas prone to xenophobic violence as authorities race to demonstrate action before the deadline passes.

media.caption: SAPS deploys R600 million operation ahead of June 30 anti-immigrant unrest deadline
